goal: Decide the safe future TUI integration contract for the frozen EntryFieldWriteAdapter without reopening runtime or enabling value/choice writes

guide_delta.summary: Für eine spätere Feldanlage muss der aktuell ausgewählte Eintrag beim Start festgehalten werden. Feldtyp, Fokus und Neuladen werden ebenfalls klar getrennt geregelt; Geld- und Auswahlfelder bleiben zunächst gesperrt, weil ihnen weitere Pflichtangaben oder Auswahlwerte fehlen.

direct_dependencies: existing stable parent capture pattern for entry creation
tests_explicitly_not_run: TUI runtime tests because runtime is not modified
product tests because no product code changes
browser tests because web code is untouched
database/domain/repository regressions because frozen core is untouched
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: MONEY cannot be safely exposed through the current three-argument adapter because FieldDefinition requires currency_code
SINGLE_CHOICE and MULTI_CHOICE definitions would be incomplete for lay users while option writes remain closed
a future runtime integration must capture entry identity and chosen type at command start and never derive them again at submit time
presentation refresh must use TuiDataPort.fields(entry_id) rather than the returned FieldDefinition directly
expected_side_effects: a later TUI reopen may be proposed only with captured entry_id, explicit safe FieldType selection, deterministic focus behavior and field-list refresh through the read port
MONEY and choice types remain excluded from the first possible TUI field-create surface
